stem: A repeated out-of-range pH result is obtained with a verified meter and correct sample. What should happen next?
choices: Apply the controlled accept/hold/escalate or authorized adjustment procedure; do not invent a chemistry change.
Keep retesting until an in-range result appears.
Delete the result and use the target value.
Change multiple ingredients until pH moves.
rationale: Apply the controlled accept/hold/escalate or authorized adjustment procedure; do not invent a chemistry change.
